evidence: Cic. Cael. 58: ipsīus venēnī quae ratiō fingitur? (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: At first any drug or potion, good or bad; hence the old legal formula venēnum malum (Cic. Clu. 148, Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: ipsīus venēnī quae ratiō fingitur? ubi quaesītum est? quem ad modum parātum?
phrases.english: what account is made up of the poison itself? where was it got? how was it prepared?
